result.reason: Section 11.4 reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, owes no termination charge, and Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, the newly added Section 11.3 is unnecessary to implement T4C and materially adds unrelated survival, customer-use, maintenance, payment, and confidentiality obligations. It also contains a drafting error ('it's' instead of 'its'). The margin comment's refusal of any early-termination fee is narrower than the stated fallback, but the operative language satisfies the preferred position.
